Art Coin lost approximately $331,000 (181 ETH) on May 7, 2023, due to a misconfigured Uniswap V3 liquidity pool. The pool was deployed and seeded with ETH before presale tokens were broadly distributed, enabling an early participant or bot to sell their tokens for ETH and drain most of the liquidity in moments. The root cause was an operational error: Art Coin's Uniswap V3 liquidity pool was deployed and funded before distributing ART tokens to presale participants. This allowed early recipients to immediately sell their allocations into the pool, extracting a disproportionate share of ETH before market price stabilization.
